title: Bondy – Social Gaming Platform
summary: A browser-based social gaming platform where people can host real-time party games and play instantly with friends, family, or colleagues.
impact: Built a real-time multiplayer platform with room codes, host controls, and synchronized gameplay.
Designed and launched multiple social games focused on connection, laughter, and group interaction.
Created a no-download experience optimized for mobile and desktop browsers.
Developed Bondy as an ongoing product with branding, SEO, feedback flows, and future game expansion.
